name: ITConnect
summary: Dialup/broadband ISP (ITConnect Internet Services Pty Ltd, ~2001); defunct (ACN 100 120 036).

events.details: Defunct. itConnect's own retail homepage last ran Aug 2007 and the domain redirected into NetSpeed by Apr 2008 — c. 2007-08 acquisition as proposed (later than the current c. 2004).

refs.label: The domain already redirected into NetSpeed by 3 Apr 2008.
NetSpeed consolidation notice on the domain by 19 Nov 2008; itconnect.net.au still serves NetSpeed's homepage in 2026.
